main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on post_pipeline_value

statistic.name: t with cases summed per day (day-clustered OLS t)

main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 (and top-fifth mean excess > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return on bars in the per-coin top fifth of forecast

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the top-fifth mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Every bar with a next close in its window and a post_pipeline_value is a case, the coin's mean is its mean 1-bar return over all windows, the t uses OLS score sums per UTC day without small-sample correction, the top fifth is forecast >= the coin's 80th percentile over all its windows, and missing minimum counts give 'not observable' rather than the plan's 'inconclusive'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0001156 on the check folds against +0.0003632 on every fold
